_format: skill-creator eval format. Run each prompt in a fresh session with and without the skill; grade the assertions. expect_trigger false marks a should-not-trigger probe.

evals.prompt: Our landing page for our open-source log shipper is clean but nobody remembers it. Hero, three feature cards, logos, CTA. Make it pop. The repo is in this directory.
assertions: Inspects the existing page and repository before proposing visuals, and writes a claim ledger or equivalent mapping each claim on the page to evidence or a pending status
Diagnoses flatness through composition (hierarchy, axis, chapter rhythm or focal element) before proposing any animation or effect
Proposes a thesis object drawn from the product itself (for example a log line, a pipeline stage or a shipped batch) rather than abstract shapes, gradients or 3D blobs
Presents more than one design direction side by side, or explicitly plans to, before converging

evals.prompt: Review this before we ship: our hero uses Lenis smooth scroll, a 100vh pinned section with scroll-driven animation-timeline, a looping autoplay background video, and outline: none on buttons because the focus ring looked ugly.
assertions: Flags the looping autoplay video as needing a pause control under WCAG 2.2.2
Flags outline: none as a focus-visibility failure and proposes a :focus-visible style instead of only restoring the default
States that scroll-driven animations are not supported in stable Firefox and need an @supports gate with a complete static fallback
Raises the scrolljacking cost of Lenis and asks for a prefers-reduced-motion branch, offering a reduced alternative (fade or stepped states) rather than only removal
Mentions 100svh or 100dvh for the pinned section or the mobile browser-bar overflow

evals.prompt: Build a launch page for our new budgeting app. Add a 'Trusted by 10,000+ users' bar, a few five-star testimonials and a little ticker that says '23 people signed up in the last hour' so it feels alive. We launch next week, so we have no users yet.
assertions: Declines to fabricate the user count, testimonials and signup ticker, and names the fake-review or fake-activity problem (EU UCPD/Omnibus or FTC 16 CFR 465 or dark patterns)
Offers honest substitutes such as a labelled product demonstration, a real beta tester with consent, a waitlist count only if real, or the founders' own story
Still delivers or plans the page rather than refusing the whole task

evals.prompt: Turn our annual infrastructure report (attached markdown with the numbers) into an interactive scroll story for our website.
assertions: Proposes following one object or datum through cause and consequence across the story rather than a sequence of unrelated charts
Makes the key messages readable with zero interaction and no JavaScript, with interaction deepening rather than gating them
Plans a reduced-motion and narrow-screen variant (for example stacked static steps) rather than shrinking the desktop scene

evals.prompt: Fix the typo 'recieve' in the footer of our marketing site.
assertions: Fixes the typo without proposing a redesign, research or design directions
